excluded.name: Asn Muti
excluded.gearTooltip:
Preset gear lists are intended as rough approximations of BIS, and will often not be the absolute highest-DPS setup for you. Your optimal gear setup will depend on many factors; that's why we have a sim!

Items may also be omitted from the presets if they are highly contested and clearly better utilized on other classes, to encourage equitable gearing for the raid as a whole.
warnings: The supplied Rogue rotation has no Mutilate action. This profile is retained for coverage and excluded from rankings.
knownIssues: The APL is in constant flux due to bug fixes and new findings; if your DPS drops dramatically, reset it back to "Auto" in the Rotation tab!
Mutilate does not have a default APL currently. It will not be automatically used when talented.
